changeSet.sql: UPDATE hero_roles relation SET role = upper(btrim(reference.slug)) FROM roles reference WHERE reference.id = relation.role_id

changeSet.author: dev-yahya
changeSet.sql: UPDATE hero_lanes relation SET lane = upper(btrim(reference.slug)) FROM lanes reference WHERE reference.id = relation.lane_id

changeSet.author: dev-yahya

preConditions.onFailMessage: Hero relations contain unsupported or duplicate normalized role/lane values. Resolve them before enforcing enums.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM hero_roles WHERE role IS NULL OR upper(btrim(role)) NOT IN ('FIGHTER', 'ASSASSIN', 'MAGE', 'MARKSMAN', 'TANK', 'SUPPORT')
SELECT count(*) FROM hero_lanes WHERE lane IS NULL OR upper(btrim(lane)) NOT IN ('CLASH', 'JUNGLE', 'MID', 'FARM', 'ROAM')
SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT hero_id, upper(btrim(role)) FROM hero_roles GROUP BY hero_id, upper(btrim(role)) HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicate_roles
SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT hero_id, upper(btrim(lane)) FROM hero_lanes GROUP BY hero_id, upper(btrim(lane)) HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicate_lanes

changeSet.sql: UPDATE hero_roles SET role = upper(btrim(role)) WHERE role != upper(btrim(role)); UPDATE hero_lanes SET lane = upper(btrim(lane)) WHERE lane != upper(btrim(lane));
